title: As You Like It / Two Gentlemen of Verona

location.series: Pentagram / The Public Theater case study

slide_intent: Use a visible hierarchy for multiple productions because equal inclusion need not mean equal type size.
strategic_value: The large LIKE can create an arresting seasonal poster while smaller blocks retain the second play and practical details.
demonstration: A black-framed yellow, orange and white layout gives LIKE most of the field beside narrow Public and date columns.
practical_value: Compare title emphasis, time and sponsor placement inside a strongly partitioned poster.

content_islands.name: Title and time
content_islands.spec: Place AS YOU LIKE IT centrally with the 8 PM block below.

content_islands.name: Supporting grid
content_islands.spec: Use the left strip for theater and dates, and the bottom bands for sponsors.

reference_purposes.Expression: A black-framed yellow, orange and white layout gives LIKE most of the field beside narrow Public and date columns.
reference_purposes.Application: The poster accommodates two productions, performance time, theater identification and sponsors in one partitioned layout.
